title: Directional transfer of chemical-gene effects from rodents to humans: analysis code and aggregate outputs
description: Independence-guarded meta-analysis of rodent-to-human directional chemical-gene effects in the Comparative Toxicogenomics Database (CTD). Includes Python pipeline (Aims 0-4), derived effect-key table, Ensembl/NCBI conservation anchors, aggregate tables, figures, and manuscript LaTeX sources.
